scope: Exact-byte static red-team of the one declared stable implementation set. No repair-draft bytes were inspected.

frozen_hash_closure.finding: Every source and reference digest named by the stable manifest and implementation freeze matched the exact file bytes at audit time.

live_d11_capture_seams.layers: preactivation/reset layers 1 through 15 only; exact first reset/layer 0 is excluded
live_d11_capture_seams.native20: The already-consumed native row at the same target preactivation cut; no historical tape or recomputation.
live_d11_capture_seams.e2: raw2-diag(raw pair m11), cloned before the first _copy_with_diagonal overwrite in each of the 14 interior full resets.
live_d11_capture_seams.uV: uV_1 is literal zero without a dense action; uV_l=weight2_l.T@e2_(l-1)/sigma_l^2 for l=2..15, using the current already-live weight2 transpose and carrying e2 exactly one layer.
live_d11_capture_seams.u3: Interior diag of the single live CP3 _cp_read result; final layer uses the single live _cp_k3 vector. Star/cubic contribution is not reclassified as CP3.
live_d11_capture_seams.u4: Interior supplied CP4 provider-plane diagonal; final layer uses the single phase-latched _cp4_read_diagonal result. Reset-internal CP4 reads are excluded.
live_d11_capture_seams.total4: Interior already-assembled full pre-K4 diagonal; final already-computed host quartic diagonal plus the captured final CP4 diagonal exactly once.

capture_and_source_zero_chain.finding: The adapter calls the public corrected Estimator.predict entrypoint once, captures its single internal native tape observationally, restores all hooks in finally, and the orchestrator independently requires byte-identical fresh public-parent output. Persisted capture parity, file/array hashes, role identity, and weight commitments are checked end to end.

mc_and_statistical_spelling.binding_oracle_gate: Independent A/B cross residual with 16+16 delete-one-block two-sample jackknife; raw and bias-corrected adverse 4SE upper must each be below 1e-8, plus both conventional stream guards.

hard_holds.finding: trainer.infer_numpy normalizes in float64 and explicitly casts the 24 inputs to contiguous float32 before both float32 affine layers. deploy_runtime._model_gaps subtracts/divides by float64 normalizers but never casts, so its x, hidden, and standardized head are float64 despite float32 model arrays. The deployed spelling is therefore not the frozen trained inference spelling.
hard_holds.test_gap: The synthetic suite tests trainer inference separately and tests fused deployment with a float64 head24 fixture; it never directly compares deploy_runtime._model_gaps with trainer.infer_numpy on identical float32 head24/model/normalizer bytes.
hard_holds.required_repair: Cast the normalized deploy input to contiguous fnp.float32 before affine evaluation, preserve the frozen float32 affine order, and add exact or preregistered-tolerance deploy-head versus trainer-head parity coverage.

hard_holds.finding: release_fsm BASE_BINDING_KEYS and actual_source_bindings for official_target_last omit deploy_resource_receipt_sha256, while official_target_last expected_official_bindings requires it. validate_release enforces the smaller exact keyset and the scorer enforces the larger exact dictionary; no release can satisfy both.
hard_holds.required_repair: Add the exact deploy-resource-receipt digest consistently to the canonical official release keyset and actual-source binding, then test one fully valid synthetic transaction.

hard_holds.finding: _authenticate_transaction validates a deploy resource receipt but does not include deploy_resource_receipt_sha256 in its returned transaction mapping. score_claimed_once unconditionally indexes that absent key when constructing the result.
hard_holds.required_repair: Return the authenticated resource-receipt digest and cover result construction in the valid-path test.

hard_holds.finding: The held_semantic release grants held_semantic and capture and requires meter=false, but run_held_semantic calls _run_capture_with_fresh_parity, resource_meter.meter_complete_prediction, and FlopScope, then emits the deploy resource receipt.
hard_holds.required_repair: Grant meter=true in the exact held_semantic permission set or move metering behind a separately claimed meter stage; validate that the release permits every performed action and nothing broader.

hard_holds.finding: The fit source binding hashes the implementation static receipt and three independent implementation audits, but _validate_canonical_documents returns immediately for fit and never parses their schemas, PASS/HOLD status, frozen-byte bindings, or zero-access counters. A release can therefore bind HOLD or FAIL audit bytes and still claim fit.
hard_holds.required_repair: Before fit claim, parse and require exact expected schemas, PASS statuses, manifest/freeze/source bindings, and zero-data counters for the static receipt and all independent audits.

hard_holds.finding: The implementation freeze still binds the old protocol and data freeze containing the revoked split/global/MLP/replicate seed preimage and its eight exact seeds. The corrected code and R1 receipt use mlp_seed/raw_weights/A-or-B. R1 explicitly supersedes only the old MC verification receipt, not the seed clauses in the two still-bound protocol artifacts.
hard_holds.required_repair: Bind an append-only protocol supersession that names the exact old documents/seed sections, declares them superseded for seed provenance only, and commits the corrected preimage and all eight corrected receipts.

resource_and_reporting_holds.finding: The implemented metered path intentionally retains an all-layer capture tape. The code itself records streaming_256k_claim_proven=false; this is not an integrated 256 KiB deployment receipt.
resource_and_reporting_holds.finding_parameter_bytes: The 3596-byte figure is correct for trainable float32 parameters only, not the full learned deployment numeric payload.
required_execution_evidence_after_repair: one exact complete modified-estimator FlopScope receipt below 2^41
one absolute peak-RSS receipt strictly below 8 GiB
one monotonic wall receipt strictly below 120 seconds
literal fused-versus-held numeric parity using the repaired common head spelling
a separate integrated streaming/liveness receipt before any 256 KiB claim

release_disposition.reason: The live provider/capture algebra passes static review, but the exact frozen implementation cannot lawfully or numerically complete its preregistered release chain until the hard holds are repaired and independently rebound.

required_consolidated_r1_acceptance: One immutable replacement manifest/freeze/static-verification set; no piecemeal moving-byte audit.
All six hard holds above repaired in the frozen source and reference graph.
Direct deploy-head versus trainer-head parity fixture added.
Fully valid synthetic official transaction reaches result construction and authenticates the resource receipt.
Fit release rejects a syntactically valid HOLD independent audit.
Held-semantic permission fixture rejects unauthorized metering and accepts the corrected exact permission set.

Independent Cubic, Direct, and H4 implementation audits all parse as PASS before fit claim.
